thread:
Alice K.: Hi team — I'm onboarding and trying to add API docs for the billing webhook feature. Where should new public-facing API guides live in Notion? Also who can grant edit access / are there templates? 

devex-bot: Welcome, Alice! :wave: See /onboarding/notion-setup for basics. If you need edit perms open an Okta group request to `notion-editors` or ping @notion-admin. 

Lina (she/her): Hey Alice — we keep all API design & public API guides under Product > Platform > API Reference. Example: https://redwood.notion.site/Product-Platform-API-Reference-abc123 

Lina (she/her): For internal implementation notes go under Eng > eng-platform > api-implementation.

Raj P.: If you want a consistent layout, use the 'API Spec' template (three-column header + example calls). Click ••• on a page -> Templates -> 'API Spec', then 'Duplicate' into the right space. 

Alice K.: Got it, thanks. Do I need to be added to a specific Notion workspace or page-level permission? I only have view so far.

notion-admin: You currently have view on the Product space. To get edit, file an IT access request: https://okta.company.com/app/it-requests/new (choose Notion edit access and list pages: Product/Platform/API Reference). We'll review within 1 business day. 

Michael T.: If it's code-adjacent docs, put code samples in fenced blocks and add a 'changes' changelog at the top — we use that template field. See quick snippet: 

```
POST /v1/webhooks
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>
Body: {"event":"invoice.paid"}
```

Lina (she/her): Also pro tip: tag @engineering and add the 'docs-owned-by' property to set an owner for reviews. If you want me to review once you make edits, ping me here and I'll do a pass. :mag:

Alice K.: Awesome — filing the Okta request now. Will duplicate API Spec template into Product > Platform and ping Lina for review. Thanks everyone! :tada:

devex-bot: Reminder: after creating public docs, add the page to the docs sitemap (Docs > Sitemap) so search works across the console.
